newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish thieves take pregnant woman to hospital.
newsitem.headline: Polish thieves take pregnant woman to hospital.

text.p: Three burglars who broke into a flat in the Polish city of Gdynia ended up taking the pregnant occupant to hospital -- before returning to ransack the apartment, a newspaper reported on Saturday.
Gazeta Wyborcza quoted police as saying that the men left an armed accomplice with the woman's husband while they took her to the hospital in their car after she developed pains.
They then returned to complete the robbery, the paper said, adding that police had detained the thieves on Friday.
